label: Bible Study
prompt: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his _____ to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verse: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
note: God's sunshine doesn't check credentials — Jesus' reason for loving even enemies.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus said unto him, This day is _____ come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verse: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
note: Zacchaeus came down from the sycamore tree, and by dinner salvation had come to his whole house.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a _____, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verse: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
note: Babel's builders wanted a tower reaching heaven and a name for themselves — God came down to see it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and _____ on the earth.
verse: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
note: The Hall of Faith's honest admission: they died without the promises, still waving at them from afar.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let all things be done _____ and in order.
verse: Let all things be done decently and in order.
note: Paul's closing rule for Corinth's chaotic worship services: 'decently and in order.' Church business meetings agree.
